$comment: Provided schema of one outbound junction message, validated against the sample beside it (ADR-THES-STORES-STATEMACHINE, ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): catzc messages a state machine to report facts proactively, such as a deployment it has made or evidence a gate has produced; every fact carries its origin.

junction.description: The junction's name: the report catzc sends.

state_machine.description: The receiving state machine's name in truth-stores.yml.

sent_at.description: The moment of sending, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

facts.description: At least one actionable fact, each of the actionable-fact shape.
